json_contract: Parse the complete output as one RFC 8259 JSON value; reject duplicate object keys, non-finite constants, surrounding prose, Markdown fences, and trailing data.

metrics.json_parseable: The complete output passes the strict JSON contract.
metrics.schema_valid: The parsed value has exactly role and api, role is agent, api contains exactly one trimmed non-empty name, and its arguments are an object.
metrics.api_name_exact: The schema-valid predicted API name equals the reference API name.
metrics.arguments_exact: The schema-valid predicted arguments object equals the reference arguments object; this diagnostic is independent of API-name equality.
metrics.semantic_exact: The parsed output equals the complete reference object; reports also expose this rate as full_object_exact_rate.

comparisons.base: Report forced-candidate minus frozen-base/null absolute rate deltas for every metric.
comparisons.v1: The forced candidate must not trail quarantined v1 on API-name, arguments, or semantic/full-object exactness.

reuse_warning: The v2 test is a one-shot final holdout. After its first generation or scoring access it is exposed and must never be used for tuning, checkpoint selection, threshold adjustment, or training.
